title: Ordinary signed-total tensor square for a coefficient change
statement: Let R,S,a,g:U→V and the ordinary adjunction comparison gamma:G₀K₀≅F₀H₀ be as in [lem-sf-scalar-pull-coefficient-complex-normalization], where F₀ is geometric R module pullback, H₀ scalar extension on U, G₀ scalar extension on V, and K₀ geometric S module pullback. Write T_A,T_B,T_C,T_D for the signed direct-sum total tensors on the four module categories [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Let dF:F₀T_A→T_B(F₀×F₀) and dK:K₀T_C→T_D(K₀×K₀) be the inverses of the canonical total pullback tensor isomorphisms [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and dG,dH the analogous inverses of the ordinary scalar total balancing maps, normalized by s⊗(m⊗n)↦(s⊗m)⊗(1⊗n). Then for all unbounded complexes P,Q of R_V-modules, K₀(dG(P,Q));dK(G₀P,G₀Q);T_D(gamma_P,gamma_Q)=gamma_(T_A(P,Q));H₀(dF(P,Q));dH(F₀P,F₀Q). This is an equality of ordinary cochain maps; it has no derived tensor models, derived adjunctions or localization, and assumes no flatness. The total functors are the existing proEtaleResolutionTotal [lem-sp-proetale-tensor-coefficient-resolution-square].

proof.text: Apply the proved ordinary module tensor square to each pair of terms P^p,Q^q. Its proof transposes through the two scalar/geometric adjunctions and uses their unit-normalized tensor generator formulas.

Cancel the forward total tensor isomorphisms to obtain the formula for their inverses after each image of a (p,q) summand. The composite of scalar extension with geometric pullback is a left adjoint and preserves the total coproduct. Use hom_ext_of_map in each total degree, the inverse summand formulas, and the formula for the total map of a pair of cochain maps. Naturality of scalarPullModule moves the source summand inclusion across the coefficient comparison; scalarPullComplex has this module comparison as its degree component. Both sides reduce to the ordinary module square followed by the same target summand inclusion. Cochain extensionality finishes. Neither factor changes degree, hence no additional sign occurs.

theorem scalarPull_coefficient_total_tensor
    {R S : Coefficients.{u}} (a : Change R S)
    {U V : Scheme.{u}} (g : U ⟶ V)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (pbcModules V (R.ring V)) ℤ) :
    ((proEtaleRingModulePullback g (S.ring V) (S.ring U)
        (S.pull g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
      (@inv.{u + 1, u + 2} _ _ _ _ (scalarTensorTotal (a.map V) P Q)
        (scalarTensorTotal_isIso (a.map V) P Q)) ≫
      (proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso g (S.ring V) (S.ring U) (S.pull g)
        (((pbcExtend (a.map V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((pbcExtend (a.map V)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)).inv ≫
      (proEtaleResolutionTotal U (S.ring U)).map
          (Prod.mkHom ((scalarPullComplex a g).hom.app P)
            ((scalarPullComplex a g).hom.app Q)) =
    (scalarPullComplex a g).hom.app
        ((proEtaleResolutionTotal V (R.ring V)).obj (P, Q)) ≫
      ((pbcExtend (a.map U)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map
        ((proEtaleTensorPullbackTotalIso g (R.ring V) (R.ring U) (R.pull g) P Q).inv) ≫
      @inv.{u + 1, u + 2} _ _ _ _
        (scalarTensorTotal (a.map U)
          (((proEtaleRingModulePullback g (R.ring V) (R.ring U)
            (R.pull g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
          (((proEtaleRingModulePullback g (R.ring V) (R.ring U)
            (R.pull g)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
        (scalarTensorTotal_isIso (a.map U) _ _)
